subject.title: Track initial local maintainer-archive use friction

question: Should this parent stay open as the maintainer-archive coordination tracker while the linked child issues and PRs are reviewed, or should maintainers close it once they decide the child items fully cover the remaining work?
rationale: The issue is intentionally broad and current main is only partially complete, so automation cannot infer whether maintainers still want the umbrella tracker open after the follow-ups exist.

options.title: Keep Parent Open
options.body: Keep this issue open until the child issues and open candidate PRs are landed, rejected, or explicitly deemed sufficient for the workflow.

options.title: Close After Linking Children
options.body: Close this issue manually once a maintainer confirms that the linked child issues and PRs fully preserve the remaining context.

options.title: Convert To Milestone Planning
options.body: Replace the parent issue with a maintainer-owned milestone or project plan if the workflow should be managed outside issue cleanup automation.

recommendation.title: Keep Parent Open
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until the child issues and open candidate PRs are landed, rejected, or explicitly deemed sufficient for the workflow.
